title: Ingles de hoje - Nivel C1
objective: Pratique terceiro condicional e linguagem formal em ingles (nivel C1).

phrase_breakdowns.phrase_en: Had I known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
phrase_breakdowns.phrase_pt: Se eu soubesse do transito, eu teria saido mais cedo.

phrase_breakdowns.phrase_en: The proposal was met with mixed reactions from the board.
phrase_breakdowns.phrase_pt: A proposta foi recebida com reacoes mistas pelo conselho.

phrase_breakdowns.phrase_en: It's not uncommon for prices to fluctuate during the holidays.
phrase_breakdowns.phrase_pt: Nao e incomum que os precos oscilem durante os feriados.

items.word_en: Had I known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
items.word_pt: Se eu soubesse do transito, eu teria saido mais cedo.
items.example_sentence_en: This inverted structure replaces "If I had known" in more formal speech and writing.
items.example_sentence_pt: Essa estrutura invertida substitui "If I had known" em fala e escrita mais formais.

items.word_en: The proposal was met with mixed reactions from the board.
items.word_pt: A proposta foi recebida com reacoes mistas pelo conselho.
items.example_sentence_en: "Met with" here means "received" — common in reports and formal updates.
items.example_sentence_pt: "Met with" aqui significa "recebida" — comum em relatorios e comunicados formais.

items.word_en: It's not uncommon for prices to fluctuate during the holidays.
items.word_pt: Nao e incomum que os precos oscilem durante os feriados.
items.example_sentence_en: Double negatives like "not uncommon" soften a statement in formal English.
items.example_sentence_pt: Negativas duplas como "not uncommon" suavizam uma afirmacao no ingles formal.
